answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making every identity post a slashable bond and requiring each new node to be vouched for by a distinct, already-bonded peer. Clones must then lock real capital per identity, so ten thousand puppets cost ten thousand deposits, forfeit if one duplicate attestation surfaces. Each vouch is a public thread linking two bonded agents, and anyone can trace the falcon dive of a colluding cluster to its shared funder. Honest identities, like carved ivory, keep their weight since their bond grows with history; fakes stay light and get slashed before they vote.
